Bug reports

- A clear, descriptive title
- Steps to reproduce (what you ran, what you expected, what happened)
- Relevant environment (Vercel region, local vs deployed, AI provider if relevant)
- Relevant logs or screenshots

Feature requests

- The problem this solves
- The proposed solution, if you have one
- Any alternatives you considered

Vercel / deployment issues

- Whether it reproduces on `main` deployed to Vercel, or only locally
- The Vercel build log or runtime error
- Whether a Vercel Blob store is attached (and whether `BLOB_STORE_ID` or `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` is set)
